method: Manual read-only complete relevant functions inspected; hashes/conclusions only, no source body/copy/helpers/native execution.
conclusions: Backend F10 can alternate to KEY_MENU; native Ctrl-F10 assigned ControlCodes accelerator. This leaf routes bare F10 only and preserves modifier command/browser ownership.
MenuBar ImplHandleKeyEvent rejects invisible/native-owned/disabled/input-disabled/modal menu; SystemWindow routes eligible KEYINPUT to its own MenuBar.
MenuBarWindow KEY_MENU without Shift sets auto-popup=false; inactive highlighted item becomes first root and grabs focus without popup, active highlighted item deactivates and clears saved owner.
ChangeHighlightItem saves once on initial activation; deactivation restores live saved owner or default frame document; GetFocus activates without popup, LoseFocus deactivates without restore.
Popup KEY_MENU forwards to root MenuBarWindow; PopupClosed disables document fallback, all existing popup close/dispatch semantics retained.

Logical activation validity must be tracked independently of open popup and nullable saved focus; browser explicit cycle flag maps this validity without claiming complete native focus ABI/default parity.
Native Alt/F6/mnemonics/accelerator alternate precedence/platform menu/global/frame flags and complete no-owner popup behavior remain unverified.
